name: Prophesiae Profana
text:
Enquanto você não estiver no locus, você recebe +1 [intellect], +1 [agility] e pode ignorar ataques de oportunidade.
[reaction] Após Prophesiae Profana entrar em jogo: Escolha um local revelado. Esse local se torna "o locus" até que Prophesiae Profana saia de jogo.
[action]: Mova qualquer investigador para o locus.
real_text:
While you are not at the locus, you get +1 [intellect], +1 [agility], and you may ignore attacks of opportunity.
[reaction] After Prophesiae Profana enters play: Choose a revealed location. That location is "the locus" until Prophesiae Profana leaves play.
[action]: Move any investigator to the locus.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Apoio do Submundo
text:
Permanente. Limite de 1 por baralho. Adquira durante a criação de baralho.
Seu baralho não pode incluir mais de 1 cópia de cada carta não fraqueza e não específica (por título).
Reduza seu tamanho de baralho em 5.
real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of each non-weakness, non-signature card (by title).
Reduce your deck size by 5.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Enganar o Sistema
text:
Veloz. Jogue durante qualquer janela [fast].
Ganhe 1 recurso para cada classe diferente entre as cartas que você controla.
real_text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Gain 1 resource for each different class among cards you control.
flavor: Se fosse proibido fazer isso, não estaria dentro da lei.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Suprimento Baixo
text: Permanente. Limite de 1 por baralho. Adquira durante a criação de baralho. Forçado - Quando o primeiro turno do jogo começar: Descarte as 10 cartas do topo do seu baralho.
real_text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation. Forced - When your first turn of the game begins: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck.
flavor: A única coisa que você pode fazer é rezar para que seja o bastante.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Repelir
text:
Veloz. Jogue quando um inimigo não [[Elite]] surgir em seu local.
Esse inimigo ataca você. Então evada automaticamente esse inimigo e anexe Repelir a ele.
O inimigo anexado não pode ser preparado.
real_text:
Fast. Play when a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location.
That enemy attacks you. Then, automatically evade that enemy and attach Fend Off to it.
Attached enemy cannot ready.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Seguindo o Rastro
text: Escolha um inimigo em qualquer local que não seja o seu. Mova-se duas vezes em direção a esse inimigo. Descubra 1 pista em cada local você entrar utilizando este efeito.
real_text: Choose an enemy at any location other than yours. Move twice toward that enemy. Discover 1 clue at each location you entered by this effect.
flavor: "Que comecem os jogos!"

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Marca de Cthugha
text: Usa (6 cargas). [action]: Lute. Você pode usar [willpower] em vez de [combat], e recebe +1 de valor de perícia neste ataque. Se você tiver sucesso, gaste 1 ou 2 cargas. Em vez do dano padrão, este ataque causa 1 de dano para cada carga gasta. Se você tiver sucesso por 0, perca 1 ação.
real_text: Uses (6 charges). [action]: Fight. For this attack, you may use [willpower] instead of [combat], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1 or 2 charges. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 1 damage for each charge spent. If you succeed by 0, lose 1 action.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Nkosi Mabati
text: [reaction] Após Nkosi Mabati entrar em jogo: Nomeie uma ficha de caos não [elder_sign] que tenha um símbolo. Até que esta carta saia de jogo, o símbolo nomeado é seu "selo". [reaction] Quando um investigador em seu local revelar um símbolo [cultist], [tablet], ou [elder_thing], esgote Nkosi Mabati: Procure seu selo na bolsa de caos e revele-o em vez disso (devolvendo as outras fichas para a bolsa de caos).
real_text: [reaction] After Nkosi Mabati enters play: Name a non-[elder_sign] chaos token with a symbol. Until this card leaves play, the named symbol is your "sigil." [reaction] When an investigator at your location reveals a [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol, exhaust Nkosi Mabati: Search the chaos bag for your sigil and reveal it, instead (returning the other token to the chaos bag).

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Martelo Ciclópico
text: [action]: Lute. Adicione sua [willpower] ao seu valor de perícia neste ataque. Você causa +1 de dano neste ataque. Se você tiver sucesso e o inimigo não for [[Elite]], você pode movê-lo para um local de distância de você. (Se você tiver sucesso por 3 ou mais, em vez disso, você causa +2 de dano e pode mover o inimigo para até dois locais de distância de você).
real_text: [action]: Fight. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this attack. You deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], you may move it one location away from you. (If you succeed by 3 or more, you instead deal +2 damage and may move the enemy up to two locations away from you.)
traits: Item. Relíquia. Arma. Corpo a Corpo

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Tabuleta das Eras
text:
Usa (3 segredos).
[fast] Durante o seu turno, esgote Tabuleta das Eras e gaste 1 segredo: Escolha e realize duas das seguintes ações, em qualquer ordem (mover-se, evadir ou investigar).
real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Eon Chart and spend 1 secret: Choose and take two different actions of the following, in any order (move, evade, or investigate).

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Professor William Webb
text:
Usa (3 segredos).
[reaction] Quando você investigar com sucesso, esgote Professor William Webb e gaste 1 segredo: Escolha uma carta de [[Item]] em sua pilha de descarte e adicione-a à sua mão. Em vez de descobrir uma pista em seu local, você pode descobrir uma pista em um local conectado.
real_text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[reaction] When you successfully investigate, exhaust Professor William Webb and spend 1 secret: Choose an [[Item]] card in your discard pile and add it to your hand. Instead of discovering a clue at your location, you may discover a clue at a connecting location.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Borrar
text: Usa (4 cargas). [action] Se Borrar tiver cargas restantes: Evada. Você pode usar [willpower] em vez de [agility] e recebe +2 de valor de perícia nesta tentativa evasão. Se você tiver sucesso, gaste 1 ou 2 cargas e você pode realizar essa quantidade de ações adicionais neste turno. Se você tiver sucesso por 0, sofra 2 de dano.
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action] If Blur has charges remaining: Evade. For this evasion attempt, you may use [willpower] instead of [agility] and get +2 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1 or 2 charges and you may take that many additional actions this turn. If you succeed by 0, take 2 damage.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Cão de Trenó
text: Você pode incluir até 4 cópias de Cão de Trenó em seu baralho. Até duas cartas de Cão de Trenó ocupam um único espaço de aliado. [action] Esgote X Cães de Trenó: Mova-se. Mova-se X vezes. [action] Esgote X Cães de Trenó: Lute. Você recebe +X [combat] neste ataque. Em vez do dano padrão, este ataque causa X de dano.
real_text: You may include up to 4 copies of Sled Dog in your deck. Up to 2 Sled Dog cards take up a single ally slot. [action] Exhaust X Sled Dogs: Move. Move X times. [action] Exhaust X Sled Dogs: Fight. You get +X [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals X damage.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Chamando Apoio
text:
Um de cada vez, em qualquer ordem, se você controlar uma...
- carta de [rogue], você pode se mover para um local conectado.
- carta de [guardian], cause 1 de dano a um inimigo em seu local. 
- carta de [seeker], descubra 1 pista em seu loca
- carta de [mystic], cure 1 de horror de qualquer carta.
- carta de [survivor], cure 1 de dano de qualquer carta.
real_text:
One at a time, in any order, if you control a...
- [rogue] card, you may move to a connecting location.
- [guardian] card, deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
- [seeker] card, discover 1 clue at your location.
- [mystic] card, heal 1 horror from any card.
- [survivor] card, heal 1 damage from any card.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Equipado
text: Permanente. Limite de 1 por baralho. Adquira durante a construção de baralho. Forçado - Quando seu primeiro turno do jogo começar: Jogue qualquer número de ativos de [[Item]] da sua mão, reduzindo o custo de cada um em 1. Durante este turno, você tem 3 ações a menos.
real_text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation. Forced - When your first turn of the game begins: One at a time, play any number of [[Item]] assets from your hand, reducing the cost of each by 1. During this turn, you have 3 fewer actions to take.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Transe Meditativo
text: Para cada um de seus espaços arcanos preenchidos, cure 1 de dano ou 1 de horror.
real_text: For each of your arcane slots that is filled, either heal 1 damage or 1 horror.
flavor: Você deixa sua mente vagar para o frio e inexpressivo esquecimento. O vazio é como um lar.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Previsão
text:
Veloz. Jogue quando um investigador em seu local for comprar uma carta do baralho dele ou do baralho de encontros.
Nomeie uma carta. Se a carta comprada for a carta nomeada, esse investigador pode (escolha um):
- Cancelar os efeitos da carta e descartá-la.
- Jogá-la imediatamente com -2 de custo.
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location would draw a card from their deck or from the encounter deck.
Name a card. If the drawn card is the named card, that investigator may either (choose one):
- Cancel that card's effects and discard it.
- Immediately play that card at -2 cost.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Extintor de Incêndio
text: [action]: Lute. Você recebe +1 [combat] causa +1 de dano neste ataque. [action] Descarte Extintor de Incêndio: Evada. Evada automaticamente todos os inimigos engajados com você. Você pode exilar Extintor de Incêndio em vez de descartá-lo para descartar cada inimigo não [[Elite]] evadido através deste efeito.
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [action] Discard Fire Extinguisher: Evade. Automatically evade all enemies engaged with you. You may exile Fire Extinguisher instead of discarding it to discard each non-[[Elite]] enemy evaded by this effect.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Gené Beauregard
text:
Você recebe +1 [intellect] e +1 [agility].
[reaction] Durante o seu turno, após você se mover para um local, esgote Gené Beauregard: Mova uma pista ou um inimigo não [[Elite]] de um local conectado para o seu local ou vice-versa.
real_text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [agility].
[reaction] During your turn, after you move to a location, exhaust Gené Beauregard: Move a clue or a non-[[Elite]] enemy from a connecting location to your location, or vice versa.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Protegendo o Anirniq
text:
Veloz. Jogue após um ativo de [[Aliado]] em seu local ser descartado por um efeito de carta ou ser derrotado.
Devolva o ativo para a mão de seu dono ou seu dono compra 3 cartas.
real_text:
Fast. Play after an [[Ally]] asset at your location is discarded by a card effect or is defeated.
Either return that asset to its owner's hand, or its owner draws 3 cards.
flavor: Todos os seres vivos têm um sopro. Cuidado para não se amaldiçoar com o deles.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: "Era o que Eu Precisava!"
text:
Veloz. Jogue após você revelar uma ficha de caos durante um teste de perícia.
Revele uma ficha de caos adicional, trocando seu "-" por um "+." Se essa ficha for uma ficha de [skull], você falha automaticamente.
real_text:
Fast. Play after you reveal a chaos token during a skill test.
Reveal an additional chaos token, switching its "-" to a "+". If that chaos token is a [skull] token, you automatically fail.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Esquiva
text:
Veloz. Jogue quando um inimigo atacar um investigador em seu local.
Cancele esse ataque. Então teste [agility] (1). Se você tiver sucesso, cause 1 de dano a esse inimigo
real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, test [agility] (1). If you succeed, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Treinamento de Combate
text:
Veloz. Limite de 1 [[Compostura]] em jogo.
Você recebe +1 [combat] e +1 [agility].
Todo dano/horror não direto deve ser atribuído a Treinamento de Combate antes de poder ser atribuído à sua carta de investigador.
[fast] Gaste 1 recurso: Você recebe +1 [combat] ou +1 [agility] nesse teste de perícia.
real_text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Combat Training before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Na Caçada
text: Veloz. Jogue quando você for comprar uma carta de encontro durante a fase do mythos. Em vez disso, procure um inimigo no baralho de encontros, faça-o surgir engajado com você (em vez do local em que ele normalmente surgiria), anexe Na Caçada ao inimigo e embaralhe o baralho de encontros. [reaction] Quando você derrotar o inimigo anexado: Ganhe 3 recursos.
real_text: Fast. Play when you would draw an encounter card during the mythos phase. Instead, search the encounter deck for an enemy, spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location), attach On the Hunt to it, and shuffle the encounter deck. [reaction] When you defeat attached enemy: Gain 3 resources.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Presa de Tyr'thrha
text: Lute. Escolha um inimigo em qualquer local revelado como o alvo deste ataque. Antes de resolver este ataque, você pode se mover para o local do inimigo. Adicione sua [agility] ao seu [combat] neste ataque. Este ataque causa +3 de dano.
real_text: Fight. Choose an enemy at any revealed location as the target for this attack. Before resolving this attack, you may move to that enemy's location. Add your [agility] to your [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +3 damage.
flavor: As presas de Tíndalos alcançam qualquer presa.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Espadas-Borboleta
text: [action]: Lute. Você recebe +2 [combat] neste ataque. Após este ataque, você pode lutar novamente, adicionando sua [agility]ao seu valor de perícia desse novo ataque. Se ambos os ataques tiverem sucesso, você pode esgotar Espadas-Borboleta para fazer com que o segundo ataque cause +1 de dano.
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. After this attack, you may fight again, adding your [agility] to your skill value for that attack. If both attacks are successful, you may exhaust Butterfly Swords to have the second attack deal +1 damage.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Aprendizado Forçado
text:
Permanente. Limite de 1 por baralho. Adquira durante a criação de baralho.
Aumente seu tamanho de baralho em 15.
Durante cada fase de manutenção, em vez de comprar 1 carta, compre 2 cartas e descarte 1 delas.
real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
Increase your deck size by 15.
During each upkeep phase, instead of drawing 1 card, draw 2 cards and discard 1 of them.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Arquivo de Conduítes
text:
Limite de 1 por baralho. Como um custo adicional para jogar este ativo, coloque 1 recurso em 4 locais diferentes, como linhas de ley.
[reaction] Após você investigar com sucesso um local com uma linha de ley, esgote este ativo: Mova a linha de ley para este ativo. Então, se houver 4 linhas de ley neste ativo, descarte esta carta, pegue as linhas de ley como recursos e anote no Registro da Campanha que "você identificou o portal."
real_text:
Limit 1 per deck. As an additional cost to play this asset, place 1 resource on 4 different locations, as leylines.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate a location with a leyline, exhaust this asset: Move that leyline onto this asset. Then, if there are 4 leylines on it, discard it, take its leylines as resources, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the gateway."

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Botas de Caminhada
text:
Limite de 1 [[Calçado]] por investigador. 
Você recebe +1 [agility].
[reaction] Após a última pista de seu local ser descoberta, esgote Botas de Caminhada: Mova-se para um local conectado com pelo menos 1 pista, ou então para um local conectado não revelado.
real_text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from your location, exhaust Hiking Boots: Move to a connecting location with at least 1 clue, or to a connecting unrevealed location.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Teoria Científica
text:
Veloz. Limite de 1 [[Compostura]] em jogo.
Você recebe +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat].
Todo dano/horror não direto deve ser atribuído a Teoria Científica antes de poder ser atribuído à sua carta de investigador.
[fast] Gaste 1 recurso: Você recebe +1 [intellect] ou +1 [combat] nesse teste de perícia.
real_text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Scientific Theory before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] or +1 [combat] for this skill test.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Arquivo de Conduítes
text:
Pesquisado. Usa (4 linhas de ley). Limite de 1 por baralho.
[fast]: Mova 1 linha de ley deste ativo para um inimigo não [[Elite]].
[action]: Escolha um investigador e um inimigo que tenha uma linha de ley e esteja em um local revelado. O investigador escolhido se move para esse local. Você pode remover a linha de ley para causar 1 de dano a esse inimigo.
real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
[action]: Choose an investigator, and an enemy with a leyline at a revealed location. That investigator moves to that location. You may remove the leyline to deal 1 damage to that enemy.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Arquivo de Conduítes
text:
Pesquisado. Usa (4 linhas de ley). Limite de 1 por baralho.
[fast]: Mova 1 linha de ley deste ativo para um local revelado.
[action]: Escolha um investigador e um local revelado que tenha uma linha de ley. O investigador escolhido se move para esse local. Você pode remover a linha de ley para que esse jogador realize uma ação de investigar.
real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a revealed location.
[action]: Choose an investigator and a revealed location with a leyline. That investigator moves to that location. You may remove the leyline to have them take an investigate action.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Arquivo de Conduítes
text:
Pesquisado. Usa (4 linhas de ley). Limite de 1 por baralho.
[fast]: Mova 1 linha de ley deste ativo para um inimigo não [[Elite]].
[action]: Escolha um investigador engajado com um inimigo que tenha uma linha de ley. O investigador escolhido desengaja desse inimigo e se move para um local conectado. Você pode remover a linha de ley para evadir esse inimigo automaticamente. Essa ação não provoca ataques de oportunidade.
real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to a non-[[Elite]] enemy.
[action]: Choose an investigator engaged with an enemy with a leyline. That investigator disengages from that enemy and moves to a connecting location. You may remove the leyline to automatically evade that enemy. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Arquivo de Conduítes
text:
Pesquisado. Usa (4 linhas de ley). Limite de 1 por baralho.
[fast]: Mova 1 linha de ley deste ativo para um investigador.
[action]: Escolha um investigador que tenha uma linha de ley. O investigador escolhido compra 1 carta e cura 1 de dano ou 1 de horror. Você pode remover a linha de ley para que, em vez disso, ele compre 2 cartas e cure 2 de dano ou 2 de horror.
real_text:
Researched. Uses (4 leylines). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast]: Move 1 leyline from this asset to an investigator.
[action]: Choose an investigator with a leyline. That investigator draws 1 card and heals 1 damage or 1 horror. You may remove the leyline to have them instead draw 2 cards and heal 2 damage or 2 horror.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Contraespionagem
text:
Veloz. Jogue quando você comprar uma traição não fraqueza.
Cancele o efeito de revelação dessa carta e compre a carta do topo do baralho de encontros.
[reaction] Quando você jogar Contraespionagem, aumente seu custo em 2: Mude "do baralho de encontros" para "do seu baralho."
[reaction] Quando você jogar Contraespionagem, aumente seu custo em 2: Mude "você" para "qualquer investigador."
real_text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery.
Cancel that card's revelation effect and draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[reaction] When you play Counterespionage, increase its cost by 2: Change "the encounter deck" to "your deck".
[reaction] When you play Counterespionage, increase its cost by 2: Change "you" to "any investigator".

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Savant
text: Savant ganha uma quantidade de ícones de [wild] igual à sua menor perícia além da perícia sendo testada.
real_text: Savant gains [wild] icons equal to your lowest skill other than the skill being tested.
flavor: Cinquenta por cento sorte, cem por cento habilidade.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: A Língua do Dinheiro
text:
Veloz. Jogue quando um investigador em qualquer local iniciar um teste de perícia.
Em vez do tipo de perícia indicado no teste ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], ou [agility]), esse será um teste de recurso. O valor de perícia base do investigador para esse teste é igual à metade da quantidade de recursos na sua reserva de recursos (arredondada para baixo). Compre 1 carta.
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at any location initiates a skill test.
Instead of the skill type indicated for this test ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]), this is a resource skill test. The performing investigator's base skill value for this test is equal to half the number of resources in your resource pool (rounded down). Draw 1 card.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Mercado Paralelo
text:
Veloz. Jogue no início da fase de investigação.
Uma de cada vez, revele cartas do topo do(s) baralho(s) de qual (is) quer investigador(es) até que exatamente 5 cartas tenham sido reveladas. Separe essas cartas, fora de jogo. Enquanto estiverem separadas, qualquer investigador pode jogar quaisquer dessas cartas como se estivessem na mão dele. No início da próxima fase de investigação, embaralhe as cartas que ainda estiverem separadas no baralho de seus donos.
real_text:
Fast. Play at the start of the investigation phase.
One at a time, reveal cards from the top of any investigator deck(s) until exactly 5 cards have been revealed. Set those cards aside, out of play. While set aside, any investigator may play any of those cards as if they were in their hand. At the start of the next investigation phase, shuffle each of those cards still set aside into its owner's deck.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: Verve
text:
Veloz. Limite de 1 [[Compostura]] em jogo.
Você recebe +1 [willpower] e +1 [agility].
Todo dano/horror não direto deve ser atribuído a Verve antes de poder ser atribuído à sua carta de investigador.
[fast] Gaste 1 recurso: Você recebe +1 [willpower] ou +1 [agility] nesse teste de perícia.
real_text:
Fast. Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play.
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility].
Non-direct damage/horror must be assigned to Moxie before it can be assigned to your investigator card.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] or +1 [agility] for this skill test.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Investigador
name: O Leque Preto
text:
Excepcional.
Enquanto você tiver...
- ...10+  recursos, você recebe +1 de vida e +1 de sanidade.
- ...15+ recursos, você pode realizar uma ação adicional durante o seu turno.
- ...20+ recursos, você recebe +1 em cada uma de suas perícias.

flavor: For what purpose have these people gathered? Are they the cause of the disturbances in these woods? And if so, what is their true goal?
back_flavor:
The hooded figures stand down once they realize you are not fighting them or working to disrupt their ritual. "They are not the ones from before - the interlopers who interfered with our ritual," one of them says, pulling off her hood to reveal striking red hair that glows in the firelight. Embers dance around her fingers. "Are you of the same mind as us, then?" she asks.
"nNo, Erynn," the leader of the coven answers for you. "They are lost." She studies you with harsh eyes. "How came you here?"
You explain how you awoke in the woods, how you were attacked by terrible creatures, and how you came to the center of this circle to discover the truth behind your ordeal.
"Anette, I think someone delivered them here," the red-haired witch named Erynn whispers, mystified.
"We should finish here while the circle remains closed. There may be others in these woods. Come, sisters. Let us continue our work," Anette says.

text: Locations cannot be flipped to their [[Spectral]] side.
real_text: Locations cannot be flipped to their [[Spectral]] side.
flavor: You have come to Hangman's Hill to investigate reports over the last few nights of ghost sightings and strange activities in the woods. The witch named Erynn told you to meet her here...but for what purpose?
back_text:
Spawn 1 set-aside Heretic enemy at each of the following locations: The Gallows, Heretics' Graves, Chapel Attic, and Chapel Crypt. Add 2 [per_investigator] clues to each location.
Put the set-aside Erynn MacAoidh story asset into play at the Haunted Fields, under no player's control.
Each investigator puts into play 1 set-aside Spectral Web asset, under their control.
back_flavor: Soft chanting guides you to a gloomy clearing near the abandoned chapel. A circle of witchweed surrounds the clearing, swaying gently in the breeze. At the center of the clearing, a cloaked woman kneels before an unmarked grave, far from the rest of the graveyard. You watch in quiet for a few minutes while the woman sings an old, somber melody. It reminds you somewhat of a child's lullaby, with a dark gravity that betrays its purpose. As soon as the song ends, she turns to face you. You recognize Erynn by her crimson red hair and the dark circles that hang beneath her eyes. "You again." She rises. "Have you come here for answers, as I have?"

name: In Pursuit of the Beyond
text: [reaction] When you would "banish" a ghost: You may instead place it beneath Erynn MacAoidh, Heretic side faceup. [action] If you are at Erynn MacAoidh's location, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Parley. Choose a Heretic beneath her and place it beneath this act. real_text: [reaction] When you would "banish" a ghost: You may instead place it beneath Erynn MacAoidh, Heretic side faceup. [action] If you are at Erynn MacAoidh's location, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Parley. Choose a Heretic beneath her and place it beneath this act. Objective - Help Erynn find answers by placing Heretics beneath this act. If there are 3 beneath this act, advance.
flavor: "The spirits of my kin are restless," Erynn explains. "But the knowledge they possess is too great to ignore. Please, help me learn from them."
back_flavor:
"I...I do not know what to make of this," Erynn says as you ruminate on the discoveries you've made. The spirits were indeed roused by the presence of the creature in the mist, but it almost seemed to be guiding them. Commanding them. You ask Erynn what kind of creature could do such a thing.
"She was one of us, once. The greatest of us. And perhaps the most dangerous." She sighs. It all makes sense now. There is only one witch you know of who would inspire such reverence and such fear: Keziah Mason.
"Now Anette grasps at the forbidden knowledge she once held. This ritual... I am no longer sure we should go through with it. I fear I have been a fool this whole time." Her dark gaze meets yours, unwavering. "Let me come with you. Perhaps together we can put a stop to this."

back_flavor:
After nearly an hour spent searching through the dense mist, you finally arrive at the Lodge's ritual site to find it in chaos. Members of the Silver Twilight Lodge, in robes of blue and silver, are embroiled in battle with the witches. Anette turns her attention to you, shocked and angered at your arrival. "You! What are you doing here?" She calls to her coven: "Sisters! We must not let them interfere!"
"No, Anette," Erynn replies, standing by your side. "You have gone too far this time. It is you we must stop." Unsure who to follow, the rest of the witches stand down as the two face off.
"You must complete the ritual!" Carl Sanford commands you from across the clearing. "It is the only way!"

back_text: Deck Size: 30. [[Trait]] Choice: At deck creation, choose [[Blessed]] or [[Cursed]], or choose both and gain +5 Deck Size. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards of your chosen trait(s) 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Wendy's Amulet, Abandoned and Alone, 1 random basic weakness.
back_flavor: Mama used to let Wendy play with her necklace when she was small. Mama would tell her stories, and Wendy would spin the necklace and watch as it glittered. Then, word came that her father had been lost at sea, and Mama started acting strange, drawing unusual symbols in chalk all over the house. They took Mama to the asylum, and Wendy went to the orphanage. Before they took her away, Mama gave her the necklace, to "protect her." Wendy stayed in the orphanage for several years before running away, deciding that she could take better care of herself on her own.

flavor: You arrive in Innsmouth and immediately set to work asking the townspeople if they’ve seen your Dad, the place in the photograph, or the man in the derby who dropped off the photo.
back_text:

back_flavor: You’re used to people turning you down and pushing you away, but for some reason, the locals here are even more upset at your prying questions than you could have expected. The last person you speak to is a man who reeks of fish, with pale, sickly skin and strange ridges across his neck. Next thing you know, you are being followed everywhere you go, and the lot of them don’t look all too friendly.

flavor: The longer you stick around and the more questions you ask, the more danger seeks you out. The locals eye you with anger and suspicion, and worse: strange winged creatures prowl about the rooftops, searching for prey...
back_flavor: You hide behind a sour-smelling pile of trash and wait for the pounding of heavy steps as the mob searches relentlessly for you. You don’t know why they’re after you—you were only asking questions!—but it’s clear you can’t stay here any longer. In Arkham, everyone’s gaze passes right over street urchins like you. Suddenly, you wish that were the case here, too.

Objective – Search for Dad using Mysterious Photo. The fewer cards that remain in the Leads deck, the better. If it is empty, advance.
flavor: To say that this town is less friendly than even Arkham would be an understatement.
back_flavor:
It’s no use. Maybe Dad was in Innsmouth at some point, but he’s long gone now. And the townsfolk here don’t seem too keen on anybody asking about him. Might be they know more than they’re letting on, or it might just be they’re protecting other, unrelated secrets. Either way, it’s no longer safe to stick around.
But just as you are ready to give up and head back to the bus stop to return to Arkham, you spot a man in a familiar outfit: a long wool coat and a brown derby.

real_text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
flavor: This isn’t exactly how you imagined your first foray into the Antarctic wilds. The stinging cold and lashing, frozen winds will only get worse over time.
back_text: Spawn a set-aside Skittering Nonsense at the lead investigator’s location. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Skittering Nonsense enemies and the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set into the encounter deck.
back_flavor:
"Hold on! Come see this!" one of the other team members shouts as you trudge ahead through the snow. You turn back and examine what they have found - a second set of tracks in the snow, but smaller, misshapen. Almost impossibly so.
"What in the hell could have made these tracks?" one of your party asks. You stand dumbfounded. Very little wildlife exists out here in the frozen wastes. And these tracks match nothing you’ve ever seen before. Nothing you can even imagine.
You don’t have to question what could make such tracks for long. A shape emerges from the erupting snow, twisted and deformed, like a splotch of ink spilled upon the canvas of reality. It makes
a strange, almost familiar cry that is eaten by the howling wind: "- li! -li!" Then, with terrifying speed, it rushes toward you.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: Into the White
text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
real_text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
flavor: Something dwells beneath the ice. Something you’ve never seen or heard of before, not even in William Dyer’s horrifying report. Something...unreal.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy at the revealed location with the highest shelter value.
back_flavor:
These things, these manifestations, they’re not beasts or even alien creatures like those Dyer and Danforth encountered in their last expedition. You’re not even sure they are entities at all. They have no shape, consisting of an almost proto-plasmic substance that seeps back into the ice when harmed or whenever you escape their clutches. Given the persistence of these entities and the inclement, deadly conditions of Antarctica, you know you won’t survive the night without finding shelter.
Just as you are pondering what your next move should be, the ice beneath you rumbles with tremendous force, letting out a terrifying groan. "An earthquake?" one of your party asks over the raucous noise.
"No, that’s impossible," another replies. You share a dreadful glance. Could it be one of those...things?

back_flavor: You can go on no longer. It’s not ideal, but you’ll have to make do with the shelter you’ve found. You only hope that it’s enough to keep your party from freezing... or worse.

flavor: The low-hanging sun dimly illuminates the Antarctic night. Gray clouds cover the sky, threatening an icy storm.

flavor: The storm grows closer, and with it looming in the sky, that damnable sound returns. It haunts you with its presence, worming its way into your mind. Is it the cause of this folly? This madness?

back_flavor:
As the night ends, the storm arrives in its full ferocity. Raging, icy winds and dense snowfall make your task impossible. You’ll never find the remaining team members in these conditions, and even if you did...
A hard lump of guilt and despair forms in your throat. There’s no way they would survive in this storm, not without supplies or shelter. That you are forced to choose between your life and theirs is a burden you will surely carry with you for the rest of your life. And you’ll be lucky if that's more than a couple of days.

Feeling lucky, you decide to roll the dice, striking the ground behind you and fleeing to the side. Just as you hoped, the ice is thin enough to splinter open, and the creature tumbles down through the crack, into the icy depths. You breathe a sigh of relief, thankful you did not share a similar fate.

name: Icy Depths
flavor: The violent quakes have risen to a crescendo. Any second now, you feel as though the entire ice shelf could collapse, spilling you into the frigid ocean - or worse, if your theory about the underground source of these creatures is correct.
back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
back_flavor:
Your only warning is a thin web of cracks that tears through the ice before your feet, and then a sudden explosion of mist and ink-like miasma erupts around you. The force slams you to the ground. You crawl desperately along the freezing-cold ice as the miasma reaches for you. An incomprehensible sound, like the rushing of a furious whirlwind, fills your ears. Then a thunderous crack, and you are falling - no, sliding - down along the ice toward the freezing cold waters below.
It is a wonder you are even still conscious. You summon all of your strength and cling to the ice shelf just before you plummet below. You finally haul yourself back over the edge, casting a panicked glance at the horizon, but there is no sign of any miasma or mist. The crack in the ice shelf extends for hundreds of feet in front of you, separating you from your pursuers. Somehow, you’ve unwittingly escaped...although you won’t be forgetting that near-death experience anytime soon.

When Eliyah materializes into view, you are stunned to see him without his steadfast companion, Anyu. He holds an unfamiliar woman’s hands, her wavy hair the color of a brilliant ruby. The two young lovers stare into one another’s eyes as the old train approaches. "How long do you think you will be gone?"
"I...I’m not sure," he confesses. "It is a lengthy journey. Alaska is a hell of a big place."
"So, this is goodbye, then," the woman says. She wipes angry tears from her eyes. "Will you write?"
"I’ll try, but..." he glances away.
"Right, right," she says, understanding. The train pulls into the station, its piercing squeal muffling their words. "You...fool." She leans up and kisses his cheek. "You are a fool, Eliyah."
"I...I know," he replies. "I know."

text: Revelation – Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y’quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 damage.
real_text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y'quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 damage.
flavor:
"The things once rearing and dwelling in this frightful masonry in the age of dinosaurs were not indeed dinosaurs, but far worse."
 – H. P. Lovecraft, <u>At the Mountains of Madness</u>

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: The Beating Heart
text: Forced – If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
real_text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
flavor: Five darkened paths lead away from the gateway, through icy caverns and down vaulted corridors of smooth black stone. Quiet dread fills the ancient, dormant structure.
back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Final Straw in the Campaign Guide.
back_flavor: A dark, primordial energy seeps forth from the walls, the very same miasma that has haunted your every step throughout this doomed journey. You freeze in your tracks and back away. You’ve seen the kinds of hideous shapes it can take. The kinds of memories it conjures- foul and fair alike. But not everyone sees the mirage for what it truly is...

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: The Miasma Beckons
text: Forced – If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
real_text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
flavor: Eldritch whispers and the dribbling of inky miasma permeates the once-silent ruins. Something is reaching out to you from within its walls. Calling to you.
back_text:
Check the seals controlled by each investigator (if a seal is not controlled by an investigator, skip it).
The investigator who controls the [seal_d] seal takes 1 damage (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_e] seal discards 2 random cards from their hand (4 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_c] seal takes 1 horror (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_b] seal loses 1 action (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_a] seal loses 3 resources (6 instead if the seal is activated).
back_flavor: The seals pulse with dangerous electrostatic energy, filling the icy chambers with bright blue light. You struggle to contain the power within each seal as you move quickly to put them in their proper place.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: Call of Madness
text: Forced – If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
real_text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
flavor: The gateway stirs. Whatever is calling to you from within these walls, it hears your every word, your every footstep. It knows of your presence, of your hopes, of your fears. And it yearns to be free.
back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must either suffer 1 mental trauma or shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
back_flavor: Before you can find and place all five seals, a tremendous noise fills the cavernous halls of the facility, and inky, prismatic miasma begins to seep from every inch of the walls and ceiling. Waves of creeping ichor and wafting black mist block every route but the one from which you came. You flee back to the gateway to escape or find another path forward, but by the time you reach the massive door, it is too late.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: Dormancy
text: Objective – If an activated seal is placed on The Gate of Y’quaa, advance.
real_text: Objective - If an activated seal is placed on The Gate of Y'quaa, advance.
flavor: You have decided to explore the rest of this antediluvian complex in order to find the devices that fit this strange doorway.
back_text: Check which seal was just placed (do not remove it). If it was the [seal_d] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 damage. If it was the [seal_e] seal, the investigator who placed it draws 2 cards. If it was the [seal_c] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 horror. If it was the [seal_b] seal, the investigator who placed it may take an additional action this turn. If it was the [seal_a] seal, the investigator who placed it gains 3 resources.
back_flavor: As soon as you set the seal into place, it locks into the door with an audible click. The energy stored within the seal reaches out, coursing through channels and grooves along the doorway, and lighting the entire chamber with an eerie glow. Perhaps if you can activate and place the remaining four seals, you can put a stop to this madness.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: The Great Seal
text: Objective – Place as many activated seals as you can on The Gate of Y’quaa before whatever is inside escapes. If all five seals have been placed, advance.
real_text: Objective - Place as many activated seals as you can on The Gate of Y'quaa before whatever is inside escapes. If all five seals have been placed, advance.
flavor: Placing the first of the five seals has awoken a strange power within the facility. You believe if you can find and activate the remaining seals, they will aid in containing the thing that dwells on the other side of this gate...
back_flavor: The final seal locks into place. With a hum, power flows through the facility. Small orbs embedded in the ceiling begin to light, one by one. The realization dawns on you that this sanctuary is far more advanced than you could have ever imagined.

name: Glacial Grotto
text: Forced – After Glacial Grotto is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_d] seal on it. [action]: Test [combat] (2) to shatter the ice. If you succeed, investigators at Glacial Grotto may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.
real_text: Forced - After Glacial Grotto is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_d] seal on it. [action]: Test [combat] (2) to shatter the ice. If you succeed, investigators at Glacial Grotto may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.
back_flavor:
"Other apertures were undoubtedly connected with bygone mechanical facilities - heating, lighting, and the like - of a sort suggested in many of the carvings. Ceilings tended to be plain, but had sometimes been inlaid with green soapstone or other tiles, mostly fallen now."
 – H. P. Lovecraft, <u>At the Mountains of Madness</u>

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: The Seal Weakens
flavor: Miasma has completely consumed this part of the facility. The walls and ceiling drip with polychromatic ooze, polar mist swirls through the halls, and the air shimmers with the insubstantial quality of a mirage. What manner of power is this? And how can you possibly hope to destroy it?
back_text:
Spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness enemy at the Mist-Pylon nearest to an investigator.
Check the Campaign Log. If the truth of the mirage eludes you:
You stare, dumbstruck, at the hideous phantasmagoria. The air shimmers with a dreamlike quality about its damnable form, an endless weave of intermingled nightmare and memory. The very sight of it drives you to your knees. It is the final truth. Reality was the mirage.
Each investigator searches their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and draws them one at a time in a random order, without placing them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. After resolving all of them, shuffle each of them back into their bearer’s deck.
back_flavor: From the nameless depths at the very core of the Earth, the miasma’s true form emerges. It is a shapeless thing, a creature of whirling mist and putrid ichor that screams and whispers and crawls and flies. It seeps through the walls and up from the ice; it is everywhere; it is everything.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: That Which Has No Name
text: Forced – When 1 or more doom would be put into play, if there are any copies of The Nameless Madness still set aside: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the location nearest to an investigator without a copy of that enemy that is connected to a location with a copy of that enemy. Objective – At the end of the round, if all 15 copies of The Nameless Madness are in play and not every Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this agenda.
real_text: Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play, if there are any copies of The Nameless Madness still set aside: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the location nearest to an investigator without a copy of that enemy that is connected to a location with a copy of that enemy. Objective - At the end of the round, if all 15 copies of The Nameless Madness are in play and not every Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this agenda.
flavor: Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li! Tekeli-li!
back_text:
For each Mist-Pylon that is collapsed, set 3 copies of The Nameless Madness aside.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Remove each location except The Gate of Y’quaa from the game. Investigators and copies of The Nameless Madness are not defeated by this effect. All other cards at these locations are discarded.
Put the 4 set-aside Titanic Ramp locations into play in a straight line to the right of The Gate of Y’quaa. Put the set-aside Hidden Tunnel location into play to the right of the rightmost Titanic Ramp. Place each investigator and each remaining copy of The Nameless Madness in play at the leftmost Titanic Ramp.
Remove the act deck from the game and advance to the set-aside The Final Mirage. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
back_flavor: It is too late. You cannot contain the creature that dwells beneath the mountain. All you can hope to do now is escape with your lives.

pack_name: Limiar da Terra Expansão de Campanha
name: Collapse the Pylons
text: Each revealed Mist-Pylon can be attacked as if it were an enemy. Its fight value is equal to its shroud value and its health is equal to its clue value. While it has no health remaining, it is collapsed (it remains in play). [reaction] When you discover 1 or more clues at a Mist-Pylon, spend those clues: Deal that much damage to that Mist-Pylon. Objective – At the end of the round, if each Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this act.
real_text: Each revealed Mist-Pylon can be attacked as if it were an enemy. Its fight value is equal to its shroud value and its health is equal to its clue value. While it has no health remaining, it is collapsed (it remains in play). [reaction] When you discover 1 or more clues at a Mist-Pylon, spend those clues: Deal that much damage to that Mist-Pylon. Objective - At the end of the round, if each Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this act.
flavor: Five pylons hold this facility together. Your only hope is to destroy them - and everything else.
back_text:
Set all but 3 copies of The Nameless Madness aside.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Remove each location except The Gate of Y’quaa from the game. Investigators and copies of The Nameless Madness are not defeated by this effect. All other cards at those locations are discarded.
Put the 4 set-aside Titanic Ramp locations into play in a straight line to the right of The Gate of Y’quaa. Put the set-aside Hidden Tunnel location into play to the right of the rightmost Titanic Ramp. Place each investigator and each remaining copy of The Nameless Madness in play at the leftmost Titanic Ramp.
Remove the agenda deck from the game and advance to the set-aside The Final Mirage. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
back_flavor: The facility shakes to its very core. Without the Mist-Pylons powering the structure, the nameless entity that resides within is free - and its days are numbered, as are yours. The mountain groans and trembles, threatening to collapse all around you.

pack_name: As Chaves Escarlates Expansão de Investigador
name: Charlie Kane
text:
Você tem 3 espaços de aliado extras.
[fast] Durante um teste que você estiver realizando, esgote um ativo de [[Aliado]] que você controla: Neste teste, você recebe +1 para o valor da perícia, mais um +1 adicional para cada ícone de perícia que esse ativo de [[Aliado]] tiver que corresponda ao tipo desse teste.
[elder_sign] efeito: +3. Prepare um ativo de [[Aliado]] em seu local.
real_text:
You have 3 additional ally slots.
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, exhaust an [[Ally]] asset you control: For this test, you get +1 skill value, plus an additional +1 for each skill icon that [[Ally]] asset has that matches this test's type.
[elder_sign] effect: +3. Ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location.
flavor: "Podemos providenciar. É só uma questão de chegarmos a termos aceitáveis.
back_text: Tamanho do Baralho: 30. Escolhas de Classe: Na criação do baralho, escolha 2 classes ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], ou [survivor]). Opções de Construção de Baralho: cartas de [[Aliado]] de níveis 0-5, cartas Neutras de níveis 0-5, cartas das suas classes escolhidas de níveisl 0-2. Requisitos de Construção de Baralho (não conta no tamanho do baralho): Bonnie Walsh, O Fardo da Liderança, 1 fraqueza básica aleatória.
back_flavor: Charlie Kane prometeu ao povo de Arkham um futuro mais seguro. Ele fez muitas promessas - impostos mais baixos, escolas melhores, redução no crime. Afinal, era parte do trabalho. E, embora algumas vezes tivesse que fazer coisas das quais não se orgulhava, Charlie sempre trabalhou pelo bem maior. Então, quando começou a ouvir os relatos, colocou o povo em primeiro lugar. Claro, ele não podia contar a ninguém. O pânico generalizado não serviria ao bem público. Além disso, quem acreditaria nele? Ainda assim, Charlie sempre teve conexões na cidade. Ele fez algumas ligações, formou uma força-tarefa e partiu para o trabalho.

name: Roland Banks
text:
[reaction] Após você derrotar um inimigo: descubra 1 pista em seu local (limite de uma vez por rodada).
[elder_sign] efeito: +1 para cada pista em seu local.
real_text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each clue on your location.
flavor: Tudo nos conformes: todos os pingos nos "is" e todos os "ts" cortados. Bem, isso tem funcionado até agora.
back_text: Tamanho do baralho: 30. Opções de Construção de Baralho: cartas de Guardião ([guardian]) de níveis 0-5, cartas de Buscador ([seeker]) de níveis 0-2, cartas Neutras de níveis 0-5. Requisitos de Construção de Baralho (não contam para o tamanho do baralho): .38 Especial de Roland, Encobrir, 1 fraqueza básica aleatória.
back_flavor: Roland sempre se sentiu confortável com procedimentos e regras. Como um agente na Organização, ele se apoiava nas diretrizes que precisava seguir em qualquer situação. Mas recentemente, seu Manual de Agente Federal tem sido completamente inútil, dados os casos que ele tem assumido. Por mais que tentasse, Roland não conseguia encontrar instruções sobre o que fazer quando confrontado por criaturas estranhas, portais interdimensionais ou magias. Se ele não os tivesse visto com os próprios olhos, nunca teria acreditado... e seus superiores jamais entenderiam. Roland sabia que precisaria lidar com tudo isso sozinho.

name: Daisy Walker
text:
Você pode realizar uma ação adicional durante o seu turno; esta ação só pode ser usada em habilidades [action] de [[Tomo]].
[elder_sign] efeito: +0. Se você tiver sucesso, compre 1 carta para cada [[Tomo]] que você controla.
real_text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on [[Tome]] [action] abilities.
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If you succeed, draw 1 card for each [[Tome]] you control.
flavor: "Conheço livros que, de tão poderosos, são capazes de reescrever a realidade."
back_text: Tamanho do Baralho: 30. Opções de Construção de Baralho: cartas de Buscador ([seeker]) de níveis 0-5, cartas de Místico ([mystic]) de níveis 0-2, cartas Neutras de níveis 0-5. Requisitos de Construção de Baralho (não contam para o tamanho do baralho): Bolsa de Daisy, O Necronomicon (Tradução de John Dee), 1 fraqueza básica aleatória.
back_flavor: Como uma respeitada bibliotecária da Universidade de Miskatonic, Daisy sempre sentiu que os livros eram as coisas mais importantes de sua vida. Ela explorava na ficção aquilo que abominava na vida real: horror, violência e medo. Até que um dia se deparou com a tradução de John Dee do Necronomicon. Era blasfemo, profano e horrível demais para ser real. Mas devido aos seus conhecimentos sobre assuntos obscuros e ocultos, Daisy sabia que havia mais realidade do que ficção nas páginas daquele livro. Ela começou a se perguntar quais outros segredos habitavam na restrita coleção da Biblioteca Orne...

name: "Skids" O'Toole
text:
[free] Durante o seu turno, gaste 2 recursos: você pode realizar uma ação adicional neste turno (limite de uma vez por turno).
[elder_sign] efeito: +2. Se você tiver sucesso, ganhe 2 recursos.
real_text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 2 resources: You may take an additional action this turn. (Limit once per turn.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. If you succeed, gain 2 resources.
flavor: "Eu não saí da prisão só pra ver o mundo acabar."
back_text: Tamanho do Baralho: 30. Opções de Construção de Baralho: cartas de Ladino ([rogue]) de níveis 0-5, cartas de Guardião ([guardian]) de níveis 0-2, cartas Neutras de níveis 0-5. Requisitos de Construção de Baralho (não contam para o tamanho do baralho): Em Fuga, Dívidas de Hospital, 1 fraqueza básica aleatória.
back_flavor: Skids não planejou uma vida no crime. Mas, às vezes, fazer a coisa certa significava ter que sujar as mãos. Os policiais não se importavam se Skids estava precisando de dinheiro para a cirurgia de sua mãe. Ela perdeu a batalha para a doença e morreu durante o segundo ano de Skids na prisão. Seu colega de cela, Brad Hollins, disse que havia coisas piores do que a morte. Todas as noites, ele reclamava e delirava em voz baixa sobre os "Antigos" e contava a Skids sobre bizarras aventuras que vivia enquanto dormia. Skids não deu muita atenção, até a noite em que acordou e viu seu colega de cela em chamas. Quando Skids finalmente saiu da prisão, ele voltou para Arkham em busca de respostas.

text:
[reaction] Após 1 ou mais de horror serem colocados sobre Agnes Baker: cause 1 de dano a um inimigo em seu local (limite de uma vez por fase).
[elder_sign] efeito: +1 para cada horror em Agnes Baker.
real_text:
[reaction] After 1 or more horror is placed on Agnes Baker: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. (Limit once per phase.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each horror on Agnes Baker.
flavor: "Lembro-me de outra vida, repleta de feitiçaria e conquistas."
back_text: Tamanho do Baralho: 30. Opções de Construção de Baralho: cartas de Místico ([mystic]) de níveis 0-5, cartas de Sobrevivente ([survivor]) de níveis 0-2, cartas Neutras de níveis 0-5. Requisitos de Construção de Baralho (não contam para o tamanho do baralho): Herança de Hiperbórea, Memórias Sombrias, 1 fraqueza básica aleatória.
back_flavor: Agnes Baker pode até ser uma despretensiosa garçonete nesta vida, mas em uma vida passada, em uma época esquecida pelo mundo moderno, ela foi uma poderosa bruxa. Começou quando ela encontrou um estranho artefato, um tipo de chave, em uma coleção empoeirada de pertences da família que estava no sótão de sua casa. Quando ela tocou o objeto, as memórias voltaram inundando sua mente com uma palavra: "Hiperbórea". Quanto mais ela explorava as visões e memórias de sua vida passada, mais seu poder aumentava... e mais apavorada ela ficava.
